prior_solution.where: Marginal decipherments on 16 of 20 letters; sibling key rebuilt in this project

conditions.human_role: Supplied the DECODE cookie; asked to try the Balbases key on the rest of the volume.

solution.what: Applied the Balbases key to all 20 remaining SEG 2559 cipher records.
Six records typed with no group boundaries read 0%; rejoined and segmented by DP over the key vocabulary.
Mapped DECODE's 'Infinity' sign in R970/R973 to c+vowel.
Key output agrees with the 16 marginal decipherments; four unmargined letters read in gist.

outcome.method_basis: All twenty letters in Fuenmayor's volume (AGR SEG 2559) were read unchanged with the Balbases 1677 key, which the project had rebuilt earlier for other letters in the same volume; sixteen carry contemporary marginal decipherments that agree with the output.
outcome.fraction_read_source: read/R*.txt headers (read.py, Balbases key): 23,463 code groups, 20,727 read = 0.883; unread are mostly DECODE transcription noise (?, *, split groups); unmargined R970 77%, R973 86%, R982 71%, R984 86%
outcome.notes: Read in part under the read bar: 0.88 of groups measured; the four unmargined letters are read only for gist because their DECODE transcriptions were not corrected from the images.

gaps.item: R970, R973, R982, R984 (unmargined letters) unread groups: R970 23%, R973 14%, R982 29%, R984 14%
gaps.detail: residue is DECODE transcription noise ('?', '*', split groups); the images were not re-transcribed, so these four are read only for gist

gaps.item: ~12% of groups across the sixteen margined letters
gaps.detail: transcription noise; margins give the sense, images not re-read
